camel_example: aliyun ossutil api seal-append-object --bucket test-bucket --key test-appendable-object --region cn-hangzhou --position 1024
description_en: Seals an appendable object created by the AppendObject operation to prevent further writes. After this operation is performed, you can configure a lifecycle rule to convert the storage class of the appendable object to Cold Archive or Deep Cold Archive
description_zh: 通过AppendObject操作创建的Appendable Object，SealAppendable 操作用于Appendable Object停止继续写入。执行该操作后，允许用户通过配置生命周期来将对应的Appendable Object存储类型转为冷归档或深度冷归档存储类型
name: SealAppendObject

parameters.help_en: The name of the appendable object
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The expected length of the object at the time of sealing
parameters.help_zh: 用于指定从用户期望Seal时该文件的长度
parameters.name: position
